{{Youmay|The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] Academy on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]|The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Naval Academy (Vogel 7)|Academy]] on [[Vogel 7]]}}
The '''Naval Academy''' was a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] officers' academy on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Mandalorian Wars]], and [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Its attendees were usually members of rich and connected families. [[Dallan Morvis]] attended while [[Saul Karath]] did not. 37 generations of the [[Klev family]] attended.
